lead_story: The Fed rates decision is the biggest macro driver right now, with investors waiting to see if the central bank will cut interest rates. The decision will be influenced by the recent easing of Middle East tensions and the resulting drop in oil prices. The Fed's decision will have a significant impact on the direction of the US dollar and the overall stock market.
